description: Mornington Peninsula's longest-running volunteer-operated community market. Held every third Saturday of the month year-round in all weather. 'Make it, Grow it, Bake it' philosophy. Homemade/homegrown produce, craft, art, plants, food. Animal farm and face painters for kids; live music buskers. Proceeds support Boneo Tennis Club, Cricket Club and Primary School.
weatherDependency: Outdoor – runs in all weather conditions
nearbyAttractions: Rye beach; Rye Foreshore playground; Rosebud foreshore
suggestedItineraryPairing: Morning market then Rye beach afternoon
internalNotes: Next confirmed date: 16 May 2026. Year-round monthly pattern confirmed by multiple sources. Individual future dates follow 3rd Saturday pattern.
